questions.q: Who has the oven-baked tortilla pita become a new favorite for?
questions.e: In the video: "je mom mužu i deci bukvalno postala novi favorit" — it literally became the new favorite of my husband and children.

questions.q: What, according to the author, is the main secret of the recipe?
questions.e: In the video: "Ali prava tajna je u sirevima" — but the real secret is in the cheeses.

questions.q: Which cheese does the author call next level?
questions.e: In the video: "onaj dimljeni sir, ljudi, to je next level" — that smoked cheese, folks, is next level.

questions.q: How long and at what temperature is the pita baked?
questions.e: In the video: "U rernu na 180 stepeni 20 minuta" — in the oven at 180 degrees for 20 minutes.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Onaj *dimljeni* sir, ljudi, to je next level.
Kora je *hrskava*, a unutrašnjost previše kremasta.
Slažete tortilju, fil, pa narendate sir i tako u ___.
questions.e: U + accusative case in answer to "where to?": u krug — "in a circle".

questions.q: Sve što vam treba je malo parizera ili ___.
questions.e: After malo ("a little") the genitive case is used: malo šunke.

questions.q: Koristim Podgorac ___ jer daju neverovatan šmek.
questions.e: Koristiti ("to use") requires the accusative case; the plural of sir is sirevi, in the accusative sireve.
The subject is plural (husband and boys), so the verb is in the 3rd person plural: obožavaju.
